question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 4.**
solution:
The correct answer is: **Perspectives**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Perspectives **refer to a person's point of view or opinion on a particular matter. (किसी विशेष मामले पर किसी व्यक्ति का दृष्टिकोण या राय)

 
 
• **Example**: *His perspective on the situation was shaped by personal experiences, leading to a unique and insightful point of view.*
 
 
 
• In the given context of the sentence 'perspectives' is the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

Thus, **option 3** is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Fears **refer to a person's apprehension or anxiety towards a particular situation or thing. (किसी विशेष स्थिति या वस्तु के प्रति व्यक्ति की आशंका या चिंता)
 
• **Assumptions **refer to a person's belief or idea about something without any proof or evidence. (किसी बात के बारे में बिना किसी प्रमाण या प्रमाण के किसी व्यक्ति का विश्वास या विचार)
 
• **Biases **refer to a person's inclination or prejudice towards a particular thing or group. (किसी व्यक्ति का किसी विशेष वस्तु या समूह के प्रति झुकाव या पूर्वाग्रह)
